subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Elaborate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Complex**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elaborate **means to give more details or explanations about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में अधिक विवरण या स्पष्टीकरण देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She asked him to elaborate on the intricate details of the project to ensure a thorough understanding.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Complex **is a synonym of elaborate because it implies that something is made up of multiple interconnected parts and requires a lot of explanation. (कोई चीज़ कई परस्पर जुड़े भागों से बनी होती है और इसके लिए बहुत अधिक स्पष्टीकरण की आवश्यकता होती है)
 
 
• **Example**: *The novel's plot was so complex that it required multiple readings to grasp all its intricacies.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Easy **means something is not difficult and can be done with little effort. (कुछ भी कठिन नहीं है और थोड़े प्रयास से किया जा सकता है)
 
• **Simple **means something is easy to understand or do. (कुछ समझना या करना आसान है)
 
• **Plain **means something is not fancy or elaborate. (कुछ फैंसी या विस्तृत नहीं है)
